mapper.update: update t_esp32_node set del_flag = 0, status = 0, current_clients = 0, last_heartbeat = null where node_id = #{nodeId} and del_flag = 1

update t_esp32_node set status = #{offlineStatus},current_clients = 0, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where del_flag = 0 and status = #{onlineStatus} and last_heartbeat is not null and last_heartbeat <= #{cutoff}
